content.subject: ShipBob funding and reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,
ShipBob raised $200M, reaching a $1B+ valuation. Such rapid capital influx often expands reconciliation workloads, creating hidden manual effort across teams and cost pressure.
We deploy an automated ledger-matching engine that continuously aligns intercompany entries using real‑time data feeds to reduce latency.
Worth a 15-minute call next week?
